car.mass.extraction: 1/body.inverse_mass only for finite strictly positive inverse mass and validated car/body ownership
car.mass.evidence_status: Implemented in read_live.py; bounded consist aggregate observation retained
car.mass.limitations: Zero,negative,nonfinite or unavailable inverse mass yields unavailable mass,not zero or infinite mass. Body mass provenance differs from definition mass. Do not infer dynamic fuel/load effects from one reciprocal value.

train.total_mass.extraction: Sum finite positive reciprocal body masses over one complete validated connected-car traversal; unavailable if any member/ownership/link is invalid
train.total_mass.evidence_status: 23-car player physics-body sum2551687.039209917 observed beside stored definition aggregate2551687.0
train.total_mass.limitations: Not the native definition-mass aggregate train+9a. Inverse-mass and summation rounding differ; dynamic load/fuel inclusion and physical AI equivalence are unvalidated. Partial traversal must not be reported as a full total.

train.car_count.extraction: Count one complete bounded connected-car chain with reciprocal links and train ownership verified; unavailable on partial traversal,error,cycle or inconsistent roots
train.car_count.evidence_status: Player coupling/separation fixture validates connected chain1->6->1 while physical-list count remains40
train.car_count.limitations: Connected membership differs from physical-object count and persistent AI-service count. Stable count/root alone is not a coherent snapshot; five incomplete reads occurred in coupling evidence. Null owner may represent valid loose stock.

car.acceleration.extraction: Difference of finite stored body-velocity vectors divided by a separately justified positive producer-time interval,with stable body/car identity and coordinate frame
car.acceleration.evidence_status: Derived hypothesis; distinct player/AI clock comparisons invalidate assuming one universal gameplay-time denominator
car.acceleration.limitations: Reject resets,nonpositive/nonfinite deltas,identity or origin/frame discontinuities and inconsistent endpoint reads. Player physics and AI gameplay clocks gave different agreement in a historical captured configuration;that is not universal clock selection or validation in current no-NEMT instance. No automatic fallback to wall time. Not train+96 stored filtered acceleration or proof of physical longitudinal acceleration.

train.lifecycle_events.extraction: Compare complete validated registry and ownership snapshots within one session,retaining sample brackets and explicit unavailable states;rebuild identity associations across reload
train.lifecycle_events.evidence_status: Representative player coupling/separation,AI physical removal and player reload identity behavior observed
train.lifecycle_events.limitations: A failed or partial traversal is unavailable,not despawn. Physical removal is distinct from persistent service deletion or activity completion. Polling may miss intermediate changes;addresses/IDs can be reused. Observed sample brackets are not exact native event timestamps.

car.longitudinal_speed.extraction: Dot finite stored body velocity with the validated body forward basis;retain the original basis and its normalization check
car.longitudinal_speed.evidence_status: Implemented stored-vector projection in read_live.py;moving player/AI comparisons retained,not universal trajectory speed validation
car.longitudinal_speed.limitations: Projection is signed along the supplied body axis,not automatically cab reverser or route direction. Nonunit or malformed bases invalidate a speed interpretation;do not silently normalize a corrupt record. Stored velocity can disagree with track-following position derivatives.

car.speed_magnitude.extraction: Euclidean norm of finite stored body.velocity components in their validated common frame
car.speed_magnitude.evidence_status: Mathematical stored-vector magnitude;moving comparisons expose producer-phase and clock differences
car.speed_magnitude.limitations: Unsigned 3D magnitude is not along-track speed,train+92 signed speed or proof of actual displacement rate. Intermediate body reset values and differing clocks can disagree with moving track state.

car.heading_pitch_roll.extraction: Proposed Euler decomposition of validated orthonormal body basis with explicitly chosen handedness,axis order,angle units and singularity/wrap policy
car.heading_pitch_roll.evidence_status: Orientation-angle hypothesis;no universal Euler convention or HUD agreement established
car.heading_pitch_roll.limitations: Raw basis vectors remain authoritative evidence. Do not report a numeric Euler tuple without a documented convention. Degenerate/nonfinite bases are unavailable;gimbal lock and angle wrapping are representational,not native discontinuities. World,body and track orientation are distinct.

train.relative_motion.extraction: Proposed pairwise position difference in a proven common origin/frame;distance=norm(delta),closing speed=-dot(relative velocity,unit(delta)) for nonzero distance with a defined A-to-B ordering
train.relative_motion.evidence_status: Derived relative-motion hypothesis;origin rebase and stored-vector discrepancies constrain interpretation
train.relative_motion.limitations: Specify reference points and identities for both trains. Zero separation has undefined radial direction;do not divide by zero. Do not combine abstract AI service positions and physical body positions without a validated frame/time mapping. Stored-vector closing speed is not automatically separation derivative.

car.wheel_rotation_estimate.extraction: Ideal no-slip angular speed=validated longitudinal speed divided by finite strictly positive wheel radius in matching metre units
car.wheel_rotation_estimate.evidence_status: Kinematic hypothesis only;native stored wheel rate and animation callbacks are separately traced
car.wheel_rotation_estimate.limitations: Requires the radius corresponding to the actual wheel set,not any engine radius field. Slip,gearing,eligibility/sign conventions and animation branches can differ. This estimates angular speed,not phase or actual rail adhesion;zero/missing radius is unavailable.

session.elapsed_candidate.extraction: Literal wrapped day clock minus activity start;retain as an arithmetic candidate known to fail as general elapsed time across midnight
session.elapsed_candidate.evidence_status: Observed -82799.921875 after Explore midnight versus native elapsed3600.074951171875
session.elapsed_candidate.limitations: Do not repair by adding86400 without establishing day count,reset and save semantics. Native elapsed is separate storage;this failed arithmetic candidate remains documented without a keep/drop decision.

track.curvature_magnitude.extraction: zero for straight radius=0; otherwise 1/abs(radius). Not signed vehicle-relative turn or measured physics curvature.
track.curvature_magnitude.evidence_status: native geometry parser/traversal traced and bytes verified; four definitions matched installed assets; grade remains a scoped derived candidate
track.curvature_magnitude.limitations: Reviewed against track geometry,topology,full-registry and origin findings;existing scope limitations remain applicable.

track.straight_grade_candidate.extraction: -100*tan(section_pitch), section_pitch=[section+0x2c]. Car Y/node-distance comparison supports slope in observed straight sections; direction reversal, curves and HUD sign remain unverified.
track.straight_grade_candidate.evidence_status: native geometry parser/traversal traced and bytes verified; four definitions matched installed assets; grade remains a scoped derived candidate
track.straight_grade_candidate.limitations: Reviewed against track geometry,topology,full-registry and origin findings;existing scope limitations remain applicable.

track.route_position_candidate.extraction: X=localX+2048*originTileX; Z=localZ+2048*originTileZ; Y retained; usefloat64 and stable origin/body identities.
track.route_position_candidate.evidence_status: Native conversion traced;two runs of the same originX+1boundary retain45matched player/AIcar-body identities and stable origin rereads;other boundaries/geographic conversion remain unvalidated
track.route_position_candidate.limitations: Reviewed against track geometry,topology,full-registry and origin findings;existing scope limitations remain applicable.

topology.selected_connection.extraction: pin index=input_count+selected_branch; validate against total count, then read linked node. Native reverse traversal chooses input pin zero.
topology.selected_connection.evidence_status: Native direction-dependent pin selection traced;earlier726-node traversal superseded by full732-node registry and route-ID validation;selected branch remains distinct from authority/occupancy
topology.selected_connection.limitations: Full732-node registry resolves earlier disconnected-component and eight ambiguous-ID limitations for this route build. Selected connection is a direction-dependent traversal result,not reservation,occupancy,permission or visible switch blade state;do not interpret it as a universal straight/diverging enum.

topology.route_node_id_candidate.extraction: Registry index+1 in database node table; all 732 IDs corroborated against current TDB kinds, pins and vector geometry. Preserve route-build provenance.
topology.route_node_id_candidate.evidence_status: all 732 registry-derived route IDs validated in current route; earlier geometry ambiguity resolved
topology.route_node_id_candidate.limitations: Reviewed against track geometry,topology,full-registry and origin findings;existing scope limitations remain applicable.

activity.event.horizontal_distance.extraction: Convert event tile/offset using current origin and2048m tiles; subtract first car+0x170 X/Z; sqrt horizontal squared distance
activity.event.horizontal_distance.evidence_status: Finite reconstruction supports event13 radius crossing and stop-event32 distance41.41465m
activity.event.horizontal_distance.limitations: Horizontal geometric reconstruction is independent of activation,latch and evaluator scheduling. Use first player car event-position source,not camera or body centre;retain origin and first-car identity checks.

activity.event.location_condition.extraction: distance squared < radius squared AND (TriggerOnStop=0 OR abs(player train+0x92)<double[0x7706d8])
activity.event.location_condition.evidence_status: Event13 moving radius crossing and event32 stop-required predicate/latch transitions corroborated
activity.event.location_condition.limitations: A true reconstructed predicate is not proof of event firing:activation,latch,reversible state and evaluator scheduling remain separate. Ordinary finite reconstruction is not bit-exact x87 boundary/nonfinite emulation.

electric.voltage_consist_condition.extraction: bounded lead then+a8 traversal; car flags80/84 and helper0040bad4 indirect value/bounds; see read_electric_voltage.py
electric.voltage_consist_condition.evidence_status: native display consumers traced; Acela pantograph-down transition and separate restored snapshot
electric.voltage_consist_condition.limitations: This reconstructs a conditional cab-display rule. A skipped helper is unavailable for this predicate,not false;route supply,pantograph command,derived display and actual traction current remain distinct.

car.connection_endpoints.evidence_status: native geometry path traced;8paused connections reconstructed at approximately0.14942..0.15048m; combined moving player/AI endpoint analysis preserves discrepancies and phase-sensitive outliers
car.connection_endpoints.limitations: Solver end0/end1 are not universally locomotive front/rear labels. Definition and body transforms must belong to the same validated pair;changing body buffers invalidates cross-sample comparisons.

car.connection_endpoint_distance.extraction: car+a8 paired vehicle;norm(transformed following end1-current end0)
car.connection_endpoint_distance.evidence_status: native geometry path traced;8paused connections reconstructed at approximately0.14942..0.15048m; combined moving player/AI endpoint analysis preserves discrepancies and phase-sensitive outliers
car.connection_endpoint_distance.limitations: Nonnegative solver-point distance is not signed slack or spring compression. Do not subtract an assumed rest length or infer force without the validated spring branch and definition inputs.

car.connection_endpoint_velocity.evidence_status: native vector helpers traced;8paused pairs yield near-zero residual rates,all angular velocity zero;preserved moving player/AI observations reveal orientation changes with zero stored angular velocity and nonzero position/velocity discrepancies; combined moving player/AI endpoint analysis preserves discrepancies and phase-sensitive outliers; combined moving player/AI comparison supports distinct motion time bases
car.connection_endpoint_velocity.limitations: Stored-state rigid-body formula is not universally the measured endpoint trajectory derivative. Keep cross-product ordering,coordinate frame and producer-phase limitations explicit.

car.connection_separation_rate.extraction: 0062d335:dot(following endpoint velocity-current endpoint velocity,unit(following endpoint-current endpoint));zero direction below native epsilon
car.connection_separation_rate.evidence_status: native vector helpers traced;8paused pairs yield near-zero residual rates,all angular velocity zero;preserved moving player/AI observations reveal orientation changes with zero stored angular velocity and nonzero position/velocity discrepancies; combined moving player/AI endpoint analysis preserves discrepancies and phase-sensitive outliers; combined moving player/AI comparison supports distinct motion time bases
car.connection_separation_rate.limitations: Algebraic opening sign follows defined endpoint ordering;not proof of observed gap change. Native near-zero-direction epsilon and finite-input guards must be retained;historical clock comparisons are not a universal timing correction.

service.physicalization_endpoint_distanc.extraction: sqrt(sum((service+94/fc vector - view+38 vector)^2));retain endpoint/view inputs and service gates
service.physicalization_endpoint_distanc.evidence_status: native comparison/removal paths traced;paused distance inputs and disk/live threshold match
service.physicalization_endpoint_distanc.limitations: Geometric threshold satisfaction is only part of the creation/removal decision. Null or uninitialized endpoints and inactive service gates are not valid spawning predictions;strict inequalities and both endpoint conditions matter.

audio.stream.queue_count.extraction: bounded traversal from[state+4] following node+8;unavailable on bound/cycle/error
audio.stream.queue_count.evidence_status: native consumer/helper instruction ranges match disk/live;33receivers67streams captured;bounded chain exception preserved
audio.stream.queue_count.limitations: A research traversal cap is not the native queue capacity. A truncated queue is unavailable as a full count;record count is not playing voices,audio duration or audibility.

audio.pending.nested_child_count.extraction: count children only on successful return to wrapper;unavailable on null/type/cycle/bound/error
audio.pending.nested_child_count.evidence_status: verified native construction rule;4wrappers3children each with stable full-record rereads
